plain: A speech or writing of high praise

webster.text: An oration or eulogy in praise of some distinguished person or achievment; a formal or elaborate encomium.

more.text: An encomium; praise bestowed on some eminent person, action or virtue.

example.quote: The gentleman has made a warm panegyric on the old Confederation.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 4, South Carolina House of Representatives (debate on calling the convention), Gen. CHARLES COTESWORTH, January 17, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
